# Tayseer Innovations

> Tayseer Innovations is a fintech company based in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, building AI and digital banking solutions for financial institutions across the region.

- [Connect](https://tayseerdemo.xyz/connect): Contact details and office locations in Saudi Arabia and the UAE.
